note: Collection goal in the brief is 12 independent recordings (6 development, 6 frozen test). Only 2 are available: this is NOT statistical adequacy. Both are CC0 Xiph test sequences by Taurus Media Technik hosted on Wikimedia Commons.

annotation.method: Manual review of raw decoded frames sampled every 0.4 s with only the zone outline drawn (no detector output shown). Intervals are visibility intervals rounded to 0.4 s.
annotation.reviewer_note: One reviewer (the implementing assistant), not expert consensus. Contamination: the reviewer had already seen detector event lists for both clips while building the pipeline, so the test split is NOT a blind test.
annotation.temporal_match: same event type and zone, temporal IoU >= 0.5, one-to-one
